root.label: Hundreds of prisoners released early under new rules

events.label: Hundreds of prisoners released early under new rules

slots.name: release threshold
slots.sentence: Under the latest early release scheme, eligible prisoners can now be released on a community licence after serving one-third of their jail sentence.

slots.name: release date
slots.sentence: On Thursday hundreds of prisoners were released early, under new rules introduced to prevent jails reaching capacity, with around 4,500 due to be freed by next summer.
